Theme

Latin word

nihil

pronoun, indeclinable

nothing

In this lexicon

  • nothing

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 7.9.1: nihil enim scrībis; Cic. Fam. 14.4.4: nihil est quod tē moveat

  • zero

    the recommended word · classical

  • nihil ad tē attinet: business

    classical

  • nihil prōficere: fail

    classical

  • nihil mihi longius est quam ut: look forward to

    classical

  • nihil + gen.: no

    classical

  • nihil est quod (+ subjunctive): reason

    classical

Examples

  • hoc igitur habēbis, novī nihil. quid ergō opus erat epistulā?

    so there you have it: nothing new. Then why write a letter at all?Cic. Att. 12.1.2
